title: Math & Number Ninjas
subject: Math & Numbers
description: Fun, quick-fire math puzzles, shapes, fractions, and mental calculations for swift thinkers.

questions.question: How many sides does an octagon have?
questions.fact: An octagon has 8 straight sides and 8 angles.

questions.question: What is the next number in the pattern: 3, 6, 9, 12, ...?
questions.fact: The pattern counts up by adding 3 each time: 12 + 3 = 15.

questions.question: How many minutes are in two hours?
questions.fact: There are 60 minutes in an hour, so 60 × 2 = 120 minutes.

questions.question: What shape has 3 corners and 3 straight sides?
questions.fact: A triangle always has 3 vertices (corners) and 3 sides.

questions.question: Which of these numbers is an even number?
questions.fact: Even numbers end in 0, 2, 4, 6, or 8. 34 is divisible by 2.

questions.question: How many quarters make up one whole dollar?
questions.fact: Four quarters (25 cents each) make one dollar ($1.00).

questions.question: How many centimeters are in 1 meter?
questions.fact: Centi means one hundredth; there are 100 cm in a meter.

questions.question: If you have 15 cookies and share them equally among 3 friends, how many does each get?
questions.fact: 15 divided by 3 friends equals 5 cookies each.

questions.question: What is the perimeter of a square with sides of length 4 cm?
What fraction is equal to 50%?
questions.fact: 50% represents 50 out of 100, which simplifies to 1/2.
